title: Haddock with sweetcorn salsa
summary: Haddock with sweetcorn salsa is a mexican dinner built around haddock fillets and canned sweetcorn, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat haddock fillets dry and season it. Prep canned sweetcorn and cherry tomatoes for Haddock with sweetcorn salsa so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook haddock fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook canned sweetcorn and cherry tomatoes in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Haddock with sweetcorn salsa before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice haddock fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
